parents.course: Internship in Education Policy, Organization and Leadership

ns2:section.sectionText: This internship course provides hands-on experience in designing and implementing study abroad programs. Through projects and case studies based on actual programs, students will develop essential skills for international education, including expertise in marketing, recruitment, budgeting, faculty training, pre-departure preparation, re-entry programming, onsite activities, and program evaluation. This course is ideal for graduate students seeking to transition into roles in the field of international education and program management.
